newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen leader opens three oil tanks at Aden refiner.
newsitem.headline: Yemen leader opens three oil tanks at Aden refiner.

text.p: Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh on Monday inaugurated three oil tanks at the country's ageing refinery in the southern port city of Aden.
The tanks, with a total capacity of 12,000 tonnes, capacity, were built by an Arab contractor for an estimated $4.5 million, a senior Yemeni official said.
"The authorities are currently studying a number of projects to modernise the refinery," he added.
Yemen is the Arab world's poorest country with oil production of around 350,000 barrels per day (bpd).
Its only refinery in Aden has a design capacity of 170,000 bpd, but with runs limited to 100,000 bpd because of the age and configuration of the plant which was damaged during Yemen's 1994 war.
Yemeni investors in October laid the cornerstone for a 100,000 bpd refinery, the first private venture in the country, at Ras Isa in Hudaidah province, 230 km west of Sanaa.
